body:
It was New Year's Eve. I was in a good mood, but very tired. I have wanted to try Morning Glory seeds for a while, but it is wintertime and none of the stores seem to have any. Well a couple of days ago I was in Wal-Mart and I decided to see if they had any, so I walked back to the garden shop and to my surprise I saw the big rack with flower seeds on it. I stole 7 packs of Heavenly Blue Morning Glory seeds. I got back home and found out my parents were having a New Year's party. Good, everyone will be drunk and nobody will notice my altered state.
6:00 pm - I decided it would be a good time to start on the seeds. I then ate about 80 seeds.
7:00 pm - I wasn't feeling much of anything, a little giggly. Then people started showing up for the party. My aunt and uncle got here. They had a pint of tequila, so I took about 5 shots with them. Good buzz.
8:00 pm - I thought I didn't take enough so I ate 40 more, felt the same. I started to get nauseated.
9:00 pm - Getting pissed off I wasnt feeling it enough. Got brave and ate the rest, a total of 260.
10:00 pm - I was feeling the effects. There were tracers; people on the TV looked like liquid, pretty cool. Exactly like acid.
11:00 pm - 3:00 am - I felt the seeds full force. The rest is a blur. Faces on TV had no meaning, had fake smiles. I saw endless patterns in everything. The textures of everything was distorted stripes, they smelt like candy. All sound was like it was going through a wah-wah pedal. Time was extremely slow, at times I thought it was going backwards. I came up with many ideas about how time and God works. I could almost grasp these ideas. I was content at this time. Then the party ended, my parents went to bed, and I was left alone. Then things started to get meaningless. I was getting bored with all of this. The more I wanted the trip to end the slower time got. The minute on my clock would not change. Nothing could pass the time. I started panicking. I wanted to go to sleep and wake up and it all be over. I started to get sick. I was thinking about going and telling my parents what I had done. It was about 1:00 am now. Shit! 4 hours left. I could barely get through the minute, much less 4 hours. Every minute was endless. I even thought about killing myself, but I thought it would take my to a worse place. I didnt know what reality was. Then I finally went to sleep, but Im not sure when, probably about 5:00 am.
The next afternoon I woke up about 5:00 pm very tired and drained of all energy, still not sure about reality. The trip was 2 days ago. Im fine now, and glad I had the trip. It has given me a better perspective on life. I plan on doing it again at a smaller dose, and go from there.
